newsitem.title: USA: Newmont Gold says will exceed estimates.
newsitem.headline: Newmont Gold says will exceed estimates.

text.p: Newmont Gold Co said on Wednesday that it expected earnings for the second quarter to exceed Wall Street estimates of $0.24 to $0.25 a share, before merger-related costs, despite lower gold prices.
Newmont said it produced more than one million equity ounces of gold in the second quarter of 1997 at a total cash cost of about $195 per ounce.
In addition, company president Ronald Cambre said production for the year would be roughly 3.8 million equity ounces of gold at a cash cost of under $200 an ounce.
Newmont Gold added that it would report merger-related, one-time costs of $115 million after tax in the second quarter.
The company expects to report second quarter earnings on July 30.
